class.name: AudioStreamPlaylist
class.brief_description: [AudioStream] that includes sub-streams and plays them back like a playlist.
class.description: An audio stream that can play back sub-streams in sequence. Streams can be added to the Playlist with [method set_list_stream], and shuffled with [member shuffle].

method.name: add_stream
method.description: Appends [param stream] to the end of the list. Fails if the list already holds [constant MAX_STREAMS] streams.

method.name: find_stream
method.description: Returns the index of [param stream] in the list, or [code]-1[/code] if it is not in the list.

method.name: get_bpm
method.description: Returns the BPM of the playlist, which can vary depending on the clip being played.

method.name: get_list_stream
method.description: Returns the stream at playback position index.

method.name: get_stream_index_at
method.description: Returns the index of the stream that plays at [param time] seconds from the start of the playlist, in list order (the inverse of [method get_stream_start_time]). With [member loop], times past the end wrap around like a seek; without it they return [code]-1[/code], as do negative times and an empty playlist.

method.name: get_stream_length
method.description: Returns the length in seconds the playlist gives the stream at [param index]: [code]beat_count * 60 / bpm[/code] if the stream has a BPM and a beat count, else its [method AudioStream.get_length]. [code]null[/code] entries have length [code]0.0[/code].

method.name: get_stream_name
method.description: Returns a display name for the stream at [param index]: its [member Resource.resource_name], else its file name without extension, else an empty string (built-in streams without a name). Useful for a "now playing" label together with [signal AudioStreamPlayer.track_changed].

method.name: get_stream_start_time
method.description: Returns the time in seconds at which the stream at [param index] starts, in list order: the sum of [method get_stream_length] of the streams before it. Tracks follow each other without overlap; [member fade_time] does not shorten this timeline, the previous track fades out over the start of the next one.

method.name: insert_stream
method.description: Inserts [param stream] at [param index]; the later streams move one place down. [param index] may be the list size to append.

method.name: move_stream
method.description: Moves the stream at [param from] to [param to]; the streams in between shift by one place.

method.name: set_list_stream
method.description: Sets the stream at playback position index.

members.member: Fade time used when a stream ends, when going to the next one. Streams are expected to have an extra bit of audio after the end to help with fading. The fade does not change the timeline: [method AudioStream.get_length] of the playlist is the sum of [method get_stream_length], and each track starts at [method get_stream_start_time].
If [code]true[/code], the playlist will loop, otherwise the playlist will end when the last stream is finished.
If [code]true[/code], the playlist will shuffle each time playback starts and each time it loops.
Amount of streams in the playlist. Kept for files saved before [member streams] existed; it is no longer stored.

The streams of the playlist in play order (when [member shuffle] is off), at most [constant MAX_STREAMS]. Entries may be [code]null[/code]; they are skipped. Changing the list stops running playbacks of this playlist, like [method set_list_stream]. Files saved with [member stream_count] and [code]stream_0[/code], [code]stream_1[/code], ... still load into this list.

constants.constant: Maximum amount of streams supported in the playlist.
